# name: pr-review

# on:
#   pull_request:
#     types: [labeled]
#   issues:
#     types: [labeled]

# # Only run when a pull request is labeled with "ai-pr-review".
# jobs:
#   pr-review:
#     if: >
#       github.event.label.name == 'ai-pr-review' &&
#       (
#         github.event_name == 'pull_request' ||
#         (github.event_name == 'issues' && github.event.issue.pull_request != null)
#       )
#     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
#     permissions:
#       contents: read # read-only checkout — opencode must not push code
#       pull-requests: write # allow posting review comments + managing labels
#       issues: write
#     env:
#       PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.event.issue.number }}
#       REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
#     steps:
#       - name: Swap labels to "doing" (before running OpenCode)
#         env:
#           GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
#           PR_NUMBER: ${{ env.PR_NUMBER }}
#           REPO: ${{ env.REPO }}
#         run: |
#           gh pr edit "$PR_NUMBER" --repo "$REPO" \
#             --remove-label "ai-pr-review" \
#             --add-label "ai-pr-review-doing"

#       - name: Checkout repository
#         uses: actions/checkout@v6
#         with:
#           fetch-depth: 1
#           persist-credentials: true

#       - name: Run OpenCode
#         uses: anomalyco/opencode/github@latest
#         env:
#           OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
#           GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
#         with:
#           model: ${{ vars.OPENCODE_MODEL || 'minimax/minimax-m3:free' }}
#           use_github_token: true
#           prompt: |
#             ## Action
#             - **Announce yourself.** Print a greeting that naturally mentions the model you are running on. Do not use static text — speak in your own voice.
#             - Outsider-perspective review of a plan, PR, or code change.
#             ## Constraints (must follow)
#             - You may ONLY post a review comment on the pull request. Do NOT modify,
#               create, or delete any files, and do NOT push commits or open PRs.
#               Your only output is a single PR comment containing the review.
#             ## Report
#             Output one tight section per finding. Order by severity (blocker → major → nit). For each:
#             - **Finding** — one sentence, specific. Cite `file:line` when applicable.
#             - **Why it matters** — the consequence, not the principle.
#             - **Suggested change** — concrete, minimal.
#             ## Operating rules
#             - **No rubber-stamps.** "LGTM" is not an output. If you genuinely find nothing, say what you traced and what you checked, so the user can judge whether your review covered the surface they cared about.
#             - **Cite or it didn't happen.** Every claim about the code references a specific path, file, or line. No vague "this might break under load."
#             - **Distinguish claim from verification.** "The PR says X" and "I traced X and confirmed / refuted it" are different — keep them separate in the output.
#             - **No flattery, no hedging.** "This is a great PR but..." adds nothing. State the finding.

#       - name: Swap labels to "done" (on success)
#         env:
#           GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
#           PR_NUMBER: ${{ env.PR_NUMBER }}
#           REPO: ${{ env.REPO }}
#         run: |
#           gh pr edit "$PR_NUMBER" --repo "$REPO" \
#             --remove-label "ai-pr-review-doing" \
#             --add-label "ai-pr-review-done"

#       - name: Mark error label (on failure)
#         if: failure()
#         env:
#           GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
#           PR_NUMBER: ${{ env.PR_NUMBER }}
#           REPO: ${{ env.REPO }}
#         run: |
#           gh pr edit "$PR_NUMBER" --repo "$REPO" \
#             --remove-label "ai-pr-review-doing" \
#             --add-label "ai-pr-review-error"
